name: Character Behaviors
author: Cassieandstuff
description: Skyrim's humanoid character behaviors, rebuilt from scratch. Points DefaultMale and DefaultFemale at Behaviors\Character.hkx in place of Behaviors\0_Master.hkx; vanilla's graphs stay in the load order, unreached. Hide this bundle and vanilla comes back. Not a playable game yet: anything the new graph doesn't answer does nothing.
